name: Spotify Sidebar Clean TV
description: Cleans and enlarges the sidebar library navigation for TV remote browsing

params.css: nav [class*='RootlistItem'], [class*='sidebar'] [class*='listItem'] { min-height: 48px !important; padding: 8px 12px !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } nav [class*='RootlistItem']:hover, nav [class*='RootlistItem']:focus, [class*='sidebar'] [class*='listItem']:hover { background: rgba(29,185,84,0.15) !important; outline: 2px solid #1db954 !important; } nav [class*='RootlistItem'] span, [class*='sidebar'] [class*='listItem'] span { font-size: 16px !important; } nav [class*='RootlistItem'] img, [class*='sidebar'] [class*='listItem'] img { width: 44px !important; height: 44px !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } [class*='sidebar'] [class*='search'] input { font-size: 18px !important; padding: 10px 16px !important; }
